title: Automotive Spare Parts Inventory Management System

description.en: Designed and developed an inventory management CMS for an automotive spare parts retailer, including REST APIs and frontend modules for products, inventory, locations and orders.
description.id: Merancang dan mengembangkan CMS manajemen inventaris untuk pengecer suku cadang otomotif, termasuk REST API dan modul frontend untuk produk, inventaris, lokasi, dan pesanan.
